name: Upplandsleden genom Stockholms lan
description: Stockholm County part of Upplandsleden from Barkarby through Järfälla, Upplands Väsby and Sigtuna. Official sources state that it currently stops before the Uppsala County network.
notes: Do not stitch this section to the Uppsala County Forsbyån endpoint; official sources describe a current break around Sigtuna.
SL/UL transit information is volatile. Use live trip planners before publication or travel.
The public Naturkartan GPX URL returned an error during this import; this runtime line is an endpoint corridor, not navigation-grade.

facilities.name: Gorvaln slott drinking water
facilities.description: Drinking-water tap by the open hiker rest cabin at Gorvaln slott; Naturkartan/STF says hikers can refill bottles here.
facilities.routeProximity: At the Gorvaln slott rest-cabin cluster on the Jarfalla route corridor.

facilities.name: Gorvaln slott toilet
facilities.description: Free toilet/utedass next to the hiker rest cabin at Gorvaln slott.
facilities.routeProximity: At the Gorvaln slott rest-cabin cluster on the Jarfalla route corridor.

facilities.name: Gorvaln slott rest cabin
facilities.description: Open rest cabin/Honshuset for hikers. Treat as day-use rest shelter, not as an overnight cabin.
facilities.routeProximity: At the Gorvaln slott rest-cabin cluster on the Jarfalla route corridor.

facilities.name: Gorvaln slott restaurant and cafe
facilities.description: Restaurant/cafe at Gorvaln slott. Opening hours and booking should be checked close to use.
facilities.routeProximity: At Gorvaln slott, close to the route and rest-cabin cluster.

facilities.name: Gorvaln slott grill place
facilities.description: Designated grill/fireplace by the Gorvaln slott rest-cabin area. Reserve rules allow fires only at designated grill places.
facilities.routeProximity: At the Gorvaln slott rest-cabin cluster on the Jarfalla route corridor.

facilities.name: Gorvalnsbadet toilets
facilities.description: Public toilets at the Gorvalnsbadet side beach cluster, a short detour from the GPX. Current research notes three toilets, two accessible toilets and one urinal; changing rooms should not be presented as currently available.

facilities.name: Gorvalnsbadet seasonal cafe
facilities.description: Seasonal beach cafe/cafeteria at the Gorvalnsbadet side beach cluster, a short detour from the GPX; municipality describes it as privately run and normally open with the sun June-August. Use seasonal/check-current wording.

facilities.name: Gorvalnsbadet grill place
facilities.description: Designated grill/fireplace at the Gorvalnsbadet side beach cluster, a short detour from the GPX. Municipality lists two grill places and forbids brought disposable/private grills at the beach.

facilities.name: Bruket cafe
facilities.description: Seasonal cafe at Bruket. Current municipality sources support summer cafe service; use seasonal/check-current wording.
facilities.routeProximity: At Bruket in the Gorvaln reserve area, close to the Jarfalla route corridor.

facilities.name: Bruket grill place
facilities.description: Multiple designated grill places around Bruket/Brukets friluftsbad, imported as one cluster-approximate record rather than several duplicate grills.
facilities.routeProximity: At Bruket in the Gorvaln reserve area, close to the Jarfalla route corridor.

facilities.name: Bruket toilet
facilities.description: Seasonal/portable toilet at Brukets friluftsbad; Jarfalla lists one bajamaja.

facilities.name: Sandvik grill place
facilities.description: Designated grill/fireplace at Sandvik/Scouterna Sandvik.
facilities.routeProximity: At Sandvik/Sandviks gard on the Jarfalla route corridor.

facilities.name: Gaseborg grill place
facilities.description: Designated grill place at Gaseborg, treated as a short side facility because official trail context encourages visiting the Gaseborg hillfort by Sandvik. Keep explicit detour wording.

facilities.name: Gaseborg wind shelter
facilities.description: Wind shelter/lean-to at Gaseborg near the designated grill place; short detour from the route. Naturkartan and municipal pages confirm the Gaseborg outdoor area, while shelter semantics should remain wind-shelter rather than official overnight cabin.

facilities.name: Kallhallsbadet toilets
facilities.description: Seasonal beach toilets at Kallhallsbadet. Current research indicates portable toilets; do not imply flush toilets.
facilities.routeProximity: At Kallhallsbadet near the Jarfalla route corridor and Kallhall station.

facilities.name: Kallhallsbadet cafe
facilities.description: Seasonal beach cafe/hostel service at Kallhallsbadet, usually summer-focused; use seasonal/check-current wording.
facilities.routeProximity: At Kallhallsbadet near the Jarfalla route corridor and Kallhall station.

facilities.name: Kallhallsbadet grill place
facilities.description: Designated grill/fireplace at Kallhallsbadet. Municipality says brought disposable/private grills are not allowed.
facilities.routeProximity: At Kallhallsbadet near the Jarfalla route corridor and Kallhall station.

facilities.name: Roparudden grill place
facilities.description: Public grill/fireplace beside Upplandsleden with views over Malaren and Munkholmen. Naturkartan explicitly routes walkers to it via Upplandsleden from Harva.

facilities.name: Sattrabadet toilets
facilities.description: Municipality lists portable toilets and a flushing toilet trailer by the parking area. Exact toilet sub-coordinate is not separated from the bathing-place cluster.

facilities.name: Sattrabadet grill place
facilities.description: Designated grill/fireplace at Sattrabadet with Malaren view. Local rules require grilling only at designated grill places.

facilities.name: Kairobadet toilets
facilities.description: Municipal beach toilets at Kairobadet. Treat as a short detour from the Upplandsleden corridor rather than an on-route facility.

facilities.name: Kairobadet seasonal kiosk and serving
facilities.description: Seasonal kiosk/servering at Kairobadet. Treat as a short detour and do not imply year-round food service; the municipal page was updated in 2026 but still contains summer 2025 kiosk details.

facilities.name: Kairobadet grill place
facilities.description: Designated grill place at Kairobadet. Treat as a short detour from the Upplandsleden corridor.

facilities.name: Sattra shore grill place
facilities.description: Grill/fireplace directly by Malaren along Upplandsleden, about 500 m from visitor parking.

facilities.name: Sattra shore wind shelter
facilities.description: Wind/rest shelter beside the Sattra shore grill place. Keep wording as wind shelter unless later sources prove overnight shelter use.

facilities.name: Sattra ridge grill place
facilities.description: Grill/fireplace on a ridge by Malaren along Upplandsleden. Access is more demanding after a steep climb from the easier gravel section.

facilities.name: Sattra ridge wind shelter
facilities.description: Wind/rest shelter beside the Sattra ridge grill place. Keep wording as wind shelter unless later sources prove overnight shelter use.
